body: 为虚构面包店“Field & Flour”设计一个简洁标志：一只圆面包与一根麦穗组成紧凑图形，搭配清晰的店名字标。采用暖棕单色，平面矢量视觉，适合印在小尺寸纸袋上。图形和字标置于透明背景，输出 PNG，不要店面效果图、纸张纹理或投影。

en.title: Bakery logo
en.description: Bread and wheat mark with correctly spelled Field & Flour
en.body:
## How to use

Use the exact recorded prompt. No reference image is required. Changes to the prompt or inputs create an untested variant.

## Observed result

Bread and wheat mark with correctly spelled Field & Flour. Verified PNG alpha and inspected against white; warm brown vector-like raster with slight tonal variation.

## Source and generation

The source provides an original prompt; this production uses the separately recorded working prompt. [Source](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#design-a-reusable-logo). Source-post engagement does not measure this newly generated example.

Produced with the built-in GPT Image tool. The tool did not return an exact provider model ID; GPT Image 2.6 is the research topic, not a verified version claim for this output. All reference images used here were generated for this project.

## 使用方法

使用本次实际提交的提示词，无需参考图。修改提示词或底图后属于未验证的新变体。

## 观察结果

暖棕色面包与麦穗图形搭配 Field & Flour 字标，拼写正确，PNG 保留真实透明通道。整体为矢量风格位图，仍有轻微色调变化。

## 来源与生成

来源公开原提示词；本次使用单独记录的制作提示词。[来源](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/image-prompting#design-a-reusable-logo)。来源帖互动数不代表本次新生成案例的热度。

本例使用内置 GPT Image 工具生成。工具未返回精确模型 ID；GPT Image 2.6 是调研主题，不作为本次输出的已验证版本声明。使用的参考图均为本项目新生成。
